title: Geometry of explicitly localized finite domain factors
statement: Let S be a commutative domain, C a finite etale domain S-algebra with surjective spectrum map, and D_j (j in Fin r) finite domain C-algebras with injective structure maps and compatible S-algebra structures. Let nonzero s_j in S make Spec(D_j tensor_S S[1/s_j]) -> Spec(C tensor_S S[1/s_j]) universal homeomorphisms. Let T be an S-algebra realizing S[1/(prod_j s_j)], and let U -> T be a bijective commutative-ring algebra map. For the explicit rings C' = T tensor_S C and E_j = C' tensor_C D_j, the canonical U -> C' is finite etale with surjective spectrum map, and every C' -> E_j is finite, has domain target, and induces a surjective universal homeomorphism. There is no reduced product decomposition assertion.

source.place: taking a common principal localization for the finitely many purely inseparable factors

proof.text: The product t of the s_j is nonzero. The kernel of S -> C belongs to every prime of S by spectrum surjectivity, hence to its zero nilradical. Thus S -> C and the composites S -> D_j are injective, so the images of t are nonzero.

Identify C' and E_j with localizations of C and D_j at t by localization base change and tensor associativity. The E_j are domains. Base change preserves the finite etale surjective cover and finite factor maps.
Each s_j divides t and is a unit in T. Consequently C' -> E_j is a base change of the specified universal homeomorphism over S[1/s_j], hence is universally a homeomorphism and is surjective.
The bijective ring map U -> T is an isomorphism. Transport the finite etale surjective cover properties along this base-ring isomorphism.

theorem refinement_localization_geometry
    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [IsDomain S]
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra S C]
    [Module.Finite S C] [Algebra.Etale S C]
    (hcover : Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S C))))
    (r : ℕ) (D : Fin r → Type u) [∀ j, CommRing (D j)] [∀ j, IsDomain (D j)]
    [∀ j, Algebra C (D j)] [∀ j, Module.Finite C (D j)]
    (hinj : ∀ j, Function.Injective (algebraMap C (D j)))
    [∀ j, Algebra S (D j)] [∀ j, IsScalarTower S C (D j)]
    (s : Fin r → S) (hs : ∀ j, s j ≠ 0)
    (hhomeo : ∀ j, (topologically IsHomeomorph).universally
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom S C (D j))
          (AlgHom.id S (Localization.Away (s j)))).toRingHom)))
    (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [Algebra S T]
    [IsLocalization.Away (∏ j, s j) T]
    (U : Type u) [CommRing U] [Algebra U T]
    (hUT : Function.Bijective (algebraMap U T)) :
    let C' := T ⊗[S] C
    letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := S) (A := T) (B := C)
    Module.Finite U C' ∧ Algebra.Etale U C' ∧
      Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap U C'))) ∧
      ∀ j, Module.Finite C' (C' ⊗[C] D j) ∧ IsDomain (C' ⊗[C] D j) ∧
        Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap C' (C' ⊗[C] D j)))) ∧
        (topologically IsHomeomorph).universally
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap C' (C' ⊗[C] D j))))
